title: trichoneura mollis
intro: Trichoneura mollis, commonly known as Velvet Grass or Soft Trichoneura, is a type of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Trichoneura mollis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Trichoneura mollis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative, expectorant, and bronchodilatory effects.
